payload.title: Risk without actuation
payload.statement: Uncertainty features can identify expensive wells but cannot safely choose correction sign.
payload.evidence_for: E003 forest risk prediction is useful: Spearman 0.5415 and worst-20% AUC 0.8125.
payload.evidence_against: A separate legal ridge action predicts material datum sign at 88.39% and trend sign at 89.47%, improving pooled RMSE to 10.9280 with positive spatial stress.
payload.next_test: Keep risk and action as separate outputs, package the signed action for full-training inference, and reject any risk-based router that does not beat the fixed action.
